metadata.title: Build for RBI, Inherit the EU AI Act — Regulatory Cross-Walk
metadata.author: Pratik Dhanave (Staff Engineer, ClearRoute)

rbi_free_ai.name: RBI FREE-AI Framework
rbi_free_ai.scoping_note: The 17 RE technical-scope recs cover all 13 Risk Mitigation recs (14-26) plus RE technical readiness across Innovation Enablement recs 2, 4, 6, 8; Rec 10 (Capacity Building within REs) is organizational/HR training rather than a codebase control.

eu_ai_act.name: EU Artificial Intelligence Act (amended by Digital Omnibus Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)

rbi_draft_mrm.name: RBI Draft Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management, 2026
additional_draft_mandates: Seamless one-click chatbot-to-human handoff and anti-automation-bias oversight
Independent model validation (3 lines of defense) including local validation of third-party vendor models and RMCB sign-off

india_meity_it_amendment_rules_2026.scope: Synthetically Generated Information (SGI) audio/visual labeling and provenance metadata

rbi_free_ai_recommendations.scope: Financial Sector Data Infrastructure (DPI / AI Kosh integration)
AI Innovation Sandbox (runnable offline pipeline with mocked I/O)
Incentives and Funding Support (shared compute & data fund)
Indigenous Financial Sector-Specific AI Models & per-message residency enforcement
Integrating AI with Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)
Adaptive and Enabling Policies (declarative YAML & policy DSL)
Enabling AI-Based Affirmative Action (financial inclusion)
AI Liability Framework — Graded Liability (severity grading & auto-incident reporting)
AI Institutional Framework (permanent RBI Standing AI Committee)
Capacity Building within REs (organizational Board/staff training — non-codebase scope)
Capacity Building for Regulators and Supervisors (dedicated AI institute)
Framework for Sharing Best Practices (SROs / IBA)
Recognise and Reward Responsible AI Innovation (regulators & industry)
Board-Approved AI Policy (Annexure V — declarative policy YAML)
Data Lifecycle Governance (encryption, retention, residency & append-only consent)
AI System Governance + Autonomous Systems (risk class, RBAC, caps, circuit breakers)
Product Approval & runtime drift guard (ErrRiskChanged, ErrExpired)
Consumer Protection & AI disclosure on first event
Cybersecurity (authn, RBAC, prompt-injection, PII & explainability guards)
Red Teaming (OWASP ASI-tagged adversarial corpus on every PR)
BCP for AI (deterministic fallbacks & automated failover drills)
AI Incident Reporting (Annexure VI & tamper-evident SHA-256 audit log)
AI Inventory generated directly from live runtime registry
AI Audit Framework (pinned-key Ed25519 signed exports, AIBOM & independent verification)
Disclosures (public disclosure endpoint & first-event AI notice)
AI Toolkit (7-Sutra scorecard, safety chain & dual evidence packs)

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.notes: SHA-256 chain anchored to external timestamp; reports broken chain transparently

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.control: Annexure VI incident form (RBI prescribed AI-incident report)

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.notes: Pre-dispatch enforcement including ErrRiskChanged drift guard

rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.evidence_artefact: CI automated red-team test suite (20 cases in code/redteam/corpus.json)
rbi_to_eu_crosswalk.notes: 20-case accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity regression gate mapped to OWASP Agentic Top 10 (ASI01-ASI03; ASI08 Cascading Failures & ASI10 Rogue Agents paired with circuit breakers & RFC-001)

EU AI Act Article 50 has been binding law since 2 August 2026 (legacy provider watermarking grace ends 2 December 2026; Annex III High-Risk deferred to 2 December 2027 under Digital Omnibus Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)
Versioned, board-approved Quality Management System configuration

rbi_draft_mrm_scorecard.requirement: Full model inventory, nothing running outside it
Risk tiering by materiality, complexity and autonomy
Accountable for a vendor's model, certified or not
Inventory kept 10 years, including decommissioned models
